channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Charleston Officials Celebrate New Affordable Homes and Announces New Investment
item.description: The City of Charleston and the Charleston Redevelopment Corporation (CRC) celebrated the completion of four new affordable rental homes today with a ribbon cutting at 89 Fishburne Street

item.title: WREN Condemns Two 'Extreme' Anti-Abortion Bills
item.description: The Women’s Rights and Empowerment Network (WREN) today strongly condemned H. 3537 and H. 4760, two bills that the organization says represent "a continued sweeping attack on bodily autonomy, reproductive health care, and personal freedom in SC"

item.title: Mellow Mushroom Launches Boneless Wings (and New Lemon Pepper Flavor)
item.description: Mellow Mushroom has launched a new menu item: Boneless Wings. Alongside the new munchie, the restaurant also announces its long-awaited Lemon Pepper flavor – available to order wet or dry. Both are now available to enjoy for a limited time

item.title: She’s The Veteran to host Gala on Jan. 31
item.description: On Friday, Jan. 31, She’s The Veteran will host their inaugural gala, an evening of honor, connection, and fundraising in support of women veterans’ mental health.

item.title: Commonhouse Aleworks Launches ‘CAVU-ary’ With Alcohol-Free Options for Dry January
item.description: Commonhouse Aleworks is putting its own spin on Dry January with the launch of “CAVU-ary,” a monthlong initiative spotlighting alcohol-free beverage options while keeping the full taproom experience intact.

item.title: Forward Kyler Kupka Named to ECHL All-Star Team
item.description: The South Carolina Stingrays are pleased to announce that forward Kyler Kupka has been selected as an ECHL All-Star for the 2026 Warrior/ECHL All-Star Classic, presented by Visit Allen & Allen CDC.

item.title: Coastal Community Foundation Invests $1.5 Million in New North Charleston High School
item.description: Coastal Community Foundation (CCF) is contributing a $1.5 million impact investment to Cristo Rey Charleston for a new high school in North Charleston. This capital provided the final funding needed to close on the project.

item.title: Ahoy! Hundreds of Watercraft on Display Jan. 23-25 at Charleston Boat Show
item.description: More than 200 watercraft will be on display at the Charleston Boat Show from Jan. 23-25 at the Charleston Area Convention Center Complex. The annual event is a one-stop shop for all things boating and features new model leisure watercraft and more

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Councilman Karl Brady

item.title: Local Organizations Announce Protest After Woman Fatally Shot by ICE Officer in Minneapolis
item.description: Community members and local organizations in the Lowcountry will gather Thursday, Jan. 8, at 5:30 p.m. for a protest in response to the fatal shooting of a legal observer Wednesday morning by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent in Minnesota
